data: Is the solid teal line in the right plot consistently higher than the solid purple line?

The solid teal line represents the performance for 'Simple, Lex1 → Simple, Lex2 (same verb)', while the solid purple line represents the performance for 'Comp., Lex1 → Comp., Lex2 (same verb)'. From the caption, we know that the larger gaps on the left graph indicate a limited generalization ability over the syntactic dimension, while the smaller gaps on the right graph indicate a better generalization ability over different dative verbs. This suggests that the solid teal line is consistently higher than the solid purple line across all training example counts.
